Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: A website inquiry submitted by a prospective local business client.

name.description: Name of the business owner or contact person.

contact.description: WhatsApp phone number or email address for reply.

businessType.description: Type and location of the business.

enum: Not sure yet — help me choose

message.description: Initial message describing what the client needs on their website.

status.description: Current follow-up status managed by the owner.

threadId.description: Unguessable token ID linking this inquiry to its two-way message thread.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry status was last updated.

Thread.title: Thread
Thread.description: Capability-keyed two-way conversation summary without phone or email PII.

clientUid.description: Firebase Auth UID (anonymous or signed-in) that initiated the thread.

businessType.description: Type and location of the business.

enum: Not sure yet — help me choose

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview of the latest message (updated only on creation or owner reply).

lastMessageBy.description: Who sent the most recent message.

ThreadMessage.title: ThreadMessage
ThreadMessage.description: A saved message inside a two-way conversation between the client and Emman.

threadId.description: Parent thread token ID for query isolation.

senderRole.description: Whether this message was sent by the client or Emman (owner).

senderName.description: Display name shown on the message (verified against parent thread clientName for clients).

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

ThreadLookup.title: ThreadLookup
ThreadLookup.description: SHA-256 salted contact+PIN index enabling direct chat lookup on any device only when both contact and 4-digit PIN are known.

threads.description: Strictly bounded list of thread references for this contact+PIN hash (1 to 5 items).

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized owner record allowed to view and manage client inquiries.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Client website inquiries with private contact PII readable only by the verified owner.

/threads/{threadId}.description: Capability-keyed two-way conversation headers linking clients and Emman without exposing phone/email PII.

/threads/{threadId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Saved chronological replies between a client and Emman.

/threadLookups/{lookupHash}.description: SHA-256 contact+PIN hashed index enabling cross-device chat lookup without exposing raw contacts.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Owner admin accounts authorized to manage inquiries.
